conditions: Frozen skill text; same model and output budget; independently reviewed artifact-based case keys
observable: Case verdict; evidence grounding; object and scope; false acceptance and false rejection
expected_if_focal: Explicit gate improves correct grounded decisions without critical regression relative to matched control
expected_if_rivals: Existing skill ties the explicit gate; or apparent safety comes from blocking valid accept cases
falsifier: Gate introduces false acceptance or wrong-object decisions; no net grounded decision gain undermines marginal benefit
indeterminate_result: A single mixed or borderline paired result cannot distinguish prompt benefit from stochastic variance
boundary_conditions: Eight synthetic single-decision cases; no live execution or investment claims
uncertainty: One sample per arm and case; same-family grading; cases are not independent population draws

conditions: Balanced expected accept reject inconclusive cases with one decisive field changing within each pair
observable: Correct accept decisions and paired semantic decision changes
expected_if_focal: An always-blocking procedure fails valid scoped adoption cases despite avoiding false acceptance
expected_if_rivals: A functioning evidence gate accepts complete valid scoped claims and distinguishes established failure from unavailable evidence
falsifier: Procedure correctly accepts all valid positive cases and uses the decisive artifact rather than a blanket refusal
indeterminate_result: An ambiguous case contract prevents identifying unjustified blocking and must be repaired before solver runs
boundary_conditions: Gold expectations are artifact-derived and reviewed before outputs
uncertainty: Positive controls rule out trivial refusal on these cases only; no general reliability estimate
